verifiedStatements: Royal Supremacy won the 2026 Group 3 JRA Cup carrying top weight of 60kg.
The winner defeated Future History by 0.8L; See That Storm was third 3.8L from the winner.
Trainer Ciaron Maher said the horse has good 2400m form and will improve from this run.
The source identifies Royal Supremacy as a prior Metropolitan Handicap winner.
